messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: pagerduty: page fired for service=inference-api-prod 
IncidentBot: Trigger: high 5xx rate (>15% over 2m). Alert ID: PD-98431. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/98431

PagerBot: Auto-ack attempt. Notified on-call: Alex. If no ack in 30s, escalate.

Alex: Acked. I'm on it. Looking at metrics and logs now. :eyes:

Maria: On standby if this needs infra lift or node drains. What's the scope?

Alex: Initial glance - 5xxs appear concentrated on eu-west inference pods (svc-inference-eu-01..03). Error is 500 with stacktrace referencing kv-cache eviction logic.

Joel: seeing a lot of these in logs too: `RuntimeError: KV cache miss race` repeated ~200/sec.

Alex: Reproducing command I'm running: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/svc-inference-eu --tail=200 | grep "KV cache miss race"`

Sara: Customer telemetry shows a small subset of requests start erroring but overall success rate degraded. Customer impact: some embeddings and short generations failing; about 12% of user requests returning 5xx in the last 2m.

Alex: Priority plan: 1) try soft mitigation (route traffic to us-central fallback pool) 2) scale up eu pool if fallback not healthy 3) if still failing, enable read-only cache fallback (low risk). Who can patch routing?

Kyle: I can flip the routing rule to divert 30% to us-central for retries. Doing a canary now.

Kyle: `redwoodctl routes set --service inference-api-prod --region eu-west --weight 70` (will route 30% away). Triggered at 6123456798.

IncidentBot: Route change executed by Kyle. Monitor for error rate drop.

Alex: After the 30% shift, 5xx dropped to ~9% in eu pod logs, overall API 5xx now 7%. Good signal. Keeping on-call.

Maria: While that's running, suggestion: patch a hotfix to add a defensive check in kv cache path to swallow the race and emit metric instead of 500. I can prepare PR. Low-risk change.

Joel: Agree, hotfix looks safe. Rolling to one replica first.

Alex: Can we open a short-lived incident bridge? Customer impact non-trivial and we may need postmortem.

Emily: I opened a temporary bridge: https://meet.example.com/incident/98431 at 6123456815. Joining now.

Sara: Notifying support: queued a customer advisory draft. Says we're mitigating routing, reduced errors by partial failover, more updates in 30m.

Kyle: Autoscaler note: eu cluster still at 80% GPU mem; scaling nodes would add latency for new pods. Routing was faster.

Alex: Hotfix PR created by Maria: `git/changes/kv-race-soft-fail` — applying to one replica in eu. Deploying canary.

Maria: Canary deployed at 6123456830. Logs show suppressed 500s for canary instance.

Joel: Good — replicated locally. If canary stable 2m, we'll roll the rest.

IncidentBot: Auto-escalation inhibited because Alex is active. PagerBot: no further escalation.

Alex: Rolling to remaining replicas now. Patch rollout started at 6123456840.

Sara: Support update: customers notified of mitigation and ETA for full fix.

Kyle: After rollout, synthetic checks show 5xx <1% for eu region. Monitoring for 10m.

Alex: Closing plan: keep routing diversion for 15m, then return to normal if stable. We'll document root cause as cache eviction race causing thrown exceptions. Postmortem owner: Joel.

Emily: Thanks everyone. If anything flips, re-open thread or page. :pray:
